lines.zh: 我走一趟要卸三次货。
lines.en: One trip means unloading three times.

lines.zh: 肩上的东西比我的头还大。
lines.en: The load on my back is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里省力。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, where the walking is easier.

lines.zh: 沙地烫脚，我换着脚走。
lines.en: The sand burns; I shift from foot to foot.

lines.zh: 丛林的根太密，我绕了远路。
lines.en: The jungle roots are thick, so I took the long way.

lines.zh: 队伍里我走在最里面。
lines.en: In the column I walk on the inner side.

lines.zh: 一步一步，我把食物顶在前头。
lines.en: Step by step, I push the food ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我歇一次，货不会自己走。
lines.en: I rest once, but the load will not walk itself.

lines.zh: 回程比去程慢，因为重。
lines.en: The way back is slower because of the weight.

lines.zh: 路上有蠕虫的痕迹，我换了方向。
lines.en: There were worm tracks on the path, so I turned.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很碎，但从不乱。
lines.en: My steps are small, but never out of order.

lines.zh: 通道有人让路，我点头的道是触角。
lines.en: When kin make way, I nod with my antennae.

lines.zh: 这趟运的是幼虫，走得更稳。
lines.en: This trip carries larvae, so I walk steadier.

lines.zh: 我把路线记在脚上，不记在脑子里。
lines.en: I keep the route in my feet, not my head.

lines.zh: 我把货换个肩，继续赶路。
lines.en: I shift the load to my other shoulder and keep going.

lines.zh: 队伍前面停，我就跟着停。
lines.en: The column stops ahead, so I stop too.

lines.zh: 我站着也在算还剩几趟。
lines.en: Even standing still, I count the trips left.

lines.zh: 触角抖一抖，是巢在催。
lines.en: A twitch of antennae means the hive is urging me.

lines.zh: 我把货靠在墙边，喘了一会儿。
lines.en: I lean the load on the wall and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 沙从指节缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand runs out between the joints of my legs.

lines.zh: 我等军士先过，再走。
lines.en: I let the soldiers pass before I move.

lines.zh: 巢里的食品室应该还有空位。
lines.en: There should still be room in the food store.

lines.zh: 我数了数脚边的卵，五个。
lines.en: I count the eggs by my feet: five.

lines.zh: 休息时我也挡着通道的一半。
lines.en: Even resting, I block half the passage.

lines.zh: 地上有条新的裂缝，我避开它。
lines.en: A new crack has opened in the floor; I avoid it.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有蠕虫的沙响。
lines.en: I listen for the sand-sound of a worm.

lines.zh: 这一格是我固定的歇脚处。
lines.en: This patch is my usual place to rest.

lines.zh: 我不唱歌，巢里没有这种习惯。
lines.en: I do not sing; the hive has no such habit.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，是要搬的吗？
lines.en: That thing in your hand, is it to be carried?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，货还在背上。
lines.en: I look up at you with the load still on my back.

lines.zh: 你站得离巢口太近了。
lines.en: You are standing much too close to the entrance.

lines.zh: 我记住你的鞋，回头好绕开。
lines.en: I note your boots so I can go around them later.

lines.zh: 你让一让，我这趟赶时间。
lines.en: Step aside; this trip is on a schedule.

lines.zh: 你衣领上有村庄的土味。
lines.en: Your collar carries the dirt-smell of a village.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我怕你身后的沙。
lines.en: I do not fear you; I fear the sand behind you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就把货抱紧。
lines.en: When you crouch, I hold the load tighter.

lines.zh: 你在看我的货，我很在意。
lines.en: You are looking at my load; I mind that.

lines.zh: 巢说你们是敌人，我照办。
lines.en: The hive says you are enemies, so I obey.

lines.zh: 货撒了，我先护住剩下的。
lines.en: The cargo spilled; I guard what is left.

lines.zh: 我这条腿短了一截，慢点走。
lines.en: This leg is shorter now; I walk slower.

lines.zh: 我退到墙边，把背贴住。
lines.en: I back to the wall and press against it.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我用触角敲墙。
lines.en: When it hurts, I tap the wall with my antennae.

lines.zh: 我还能走，就是不能跑。
lines.en: I can still walk, though I cannot run.

lines.zh: 壳上有裂纹，要养几天。
lines.en: There is a crack in my shell; it needs days to heal.

lines.zh: 这一下让我丢了半趟货。
lines.en: That cost me half a trip's cargo.

lines.zh: 我压着伤，继续往前挪。
lines.en: I press the hurt down and keep shuffling forward.

lines.zh: 巢会知道我在这挨了打。
lines.en: The hive will learn I was struck here.

lines.zh: 别打第二下，我搬不动了。
lines.en: No second blow; I cannot carry anything now.

lines.zh: 那是食物吗？粮仓正缺。
lines.en: Is that food? The store is short.

lines.zh: 你放下，我就搬走，不问来路。
lines.en: Put it down and I will take it, no questions asked.

lines.zh: 这味道能让整窝吃两天。
lines.en: This smell could feed the whole hive two days.

lines.zh: 我只闻一下，不咬。
lines.en: I will only sniff it, not bite.

lines.zh: 我背上的已经满了，可惜。
lines.en: My back is already full; a pity.

lines.zh: 这个得先给保育室过目。
lines.en: This must go past the nursery first.

lines.zh: 我举着触角，等你松手。
lines.en: I raise my antennae and wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 好东西要先运回去，再谈分。
lines.en: Good things go back first; sharing comes later.

lines.zh: 你抓着不放，我就不走。
lines.en: If you keep holding it, I will not leave.

lines.zh: 巢里会为这味道吵起来。
lines.en: The hive will argue over this smell.

lines.zh: 我背上的货歪了，帮我一把。
lines.en: My load has shifted; give me a hand.

lines.zh: 你撞的是货，不是我的壳。
lines.en: You hit the cargo, not my shell.

lines.zh: 通道这么窄，谁都得侧身。
lines.en: The passage is this narrow; everyone turns sideways.

lines.zh: 我掉了两粒，得回头找。
lines.en: Two pieces fell; I have to go back for them.

lines.zh: 你比我大，我该让。
lines.en: You are bigger than me; I should yield.

lines.zh: 撞散了队，后面的会骂。
lines.en: You broke the column; the ones behind will complain.

lines.zh: 我顶着你的腿，把货扶正。
lines.en: I brace against your leg and straighten the load.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，就是白跑半趟。
lines.en: That did not hurt, but it wasted half a trip.

lines.zh: 你先过，我这批不急。
lines.en: You go first; this batch is not urgent.

lines.zh: 我重新码了一遍，压得更实。
lines.en: I restacked it, packing it down tighter.

lines.zh: 这辈子轮不到我产卵。
lines.en: Laying eggs is never going to be my turn.

lines.zh: 我把别人的孩子搬来搬去。
lines.en: I carry other mothers' children from room to room.

lines.zh: 保育室的温度要刚好。
lines.en: The nursery has to stay at just the right warmth.

lines.zh: 我只想知道幼虫有没有吃饱。
lines.en: I only want to know if the larvae are fed.

lines.zh: 配对的是另一位，不是我。
lines.en: Another one pairs; not me.

lines.zh: 我见过卵，没见过自己的。
lines.en: I have seen eggs, never ones of my own.

lines.zh: 我把蛹摆整齐，像摆自己的。
lines.en: I line the pupae up as if they were mine.

lines.zh: 巢里说，劳工不用想这些。
lines.en: The hive says workers need not think of such things.

lines.zh: 那一窝里有一只长得像军士。
lines.en: One in that brood is growing up like a soldier.

lines.zh: 我数着新生的，一整天。
lines.en: I count the newborns for a whole day.

lines.zh: 这个我扛得动，给我。
lines.en: I can carry this one; give it here.

lines.zh: 我一次能带三样，第四样会掉。
lines.en: I can take three at once; a fourth would fall.

lines.zh: 落在地上的都算粮仓的。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the store.

lines.zh: 我用颚夹住，再用前脚托。
lines.en: I grip with my jaws and support it with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 碎的那份我自己留着。
lines.en: The broken share I keep for myself.

lines.zh: 这一粒太滑，试了两次。
lines.en: This grain is too smooth; I tried twice.

lines.zh: 我先把重的放下，再来拿。
lines.en: I set the heavy one down, then come back.

lines.zh: 你扔掉的东西，我照样搬。
lines.en: What you throw away, I carry all the same.

lines.zh: 巢口不许堆，我立刻清掉。
lines.en: Nothing may pile at the entrance; I clear it at once.

lines.zh: 捡的时候我贴着地面，看得清。
lines.en: I keep low when gathering, so I see clearly.

lines.zh: 有东西踩了我们的气味线。
lines.en: Something has stepped on our scent line.

lines.zh: 那边站着的，不是巢里的。
lines.en: The one standing there is not of this hive.

lines.zh: 我放下货，先看它有几只脚。
lines.en: I set the load down and count its legs first.

lines.zh: 来的是村民，我认得那味道。
lines.en: A villager is coming; I know that smell.

lines.zh: 它退得不快，可以叫军士。
lines.en: It retreats slowly; I can call the soldiers.

lines.zh: 沙在动，也许是蠕虫，也许是它。
lines.en: The sand moves; maybe a worm, maybe it.

lines.zh: 我敲墙三下，通知前面的。
lines.en: I tap the wall three times to warn those ahead.

lines.zh: 目标堵住了运货的路。
lines.en: The target is blocking the hauling route.

lines.zh: 我记住了它的位置，先不靠近。
lines.en: I mark its position and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 巢口那边站了一个影子。
lines.en: A shadow is standing at the nest mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西挡在食品室门口。
lines.en: This thing stands in the food store doorway.

lines.zh: 我退两步，把路让给能打的。
lines.en: I step back and let the fighters through.

lines.zh: 我跟着军士，只负责指方向。
lines.en: I follow the soldiers and only point the way.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就敲左边的墙。
lines.en: It goes left, so I tap the left wall.

lines.zh: 我离得远一点，货还在身上。
lines.en: I keep back a little; the load is still on me.

lines.zh: 等军士围上，我再过去清路。
lines.en: Once the soldiers close in, I clear the path.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就退到通道拐角。
lines.en: When it moves, I slip back to the corner.

lines.zh: 我用触角指，它大概看不懂。
lines.en: I point with my antennae; it likely cannot tell.

lines.zh: 这条路上，我们人多。
lines.en: On this route, we have the numbers.

lines.zh: 我把货放下，腾出两只脚。
lines.en: I set the load down and free two legs.

lines.zh: 我不咬，只在旁边挡。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only block from the side.

lines.zh: 它跑不快，这里的沙太软。
lines.en: It cannot run fast; the sand here is soft.

lines.zh: 我听见军士的颚在响。
lines.en: I hear the soldiers' jaws clicking.

lines.zh: 我守在路口，不让它绕后。
lines.en: I hold the junction so it cannot circle behind.

lines.zh: 我咬得浅，但咬得住。
lines.en: My bite is shallow, but it holds.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，货掉了一地。
lines.en: I lunge, and the load scatters on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一口是巢教的。
lines.en: The hive taught me this bite.

lines.zh: 我顾着货，只能咬一下。
lines.en: I am minding the cargo, so just one bite.

lines.zh: 我的颚小，专挑手背。
lines.en: My jaws are small; I go for the back of the hand.

lines.zh: 咬完我就去捡散落的。
lines.en: After biting, I go pick up what scattered.

lines.zh: 我拖住它的脚，等军士来。
lines.en: I drag at its foot until the soldiers arrive.

lines.zh: 我没练过，只知道往前。
lines.en: I have never trained; I only know forward.

lines.zh: 它踢我，我咬着不放。
lines.en: It kicks me, and I keep my jaws shut.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我还得运货。
lines.en: After this fight, I still have cargo to move.

lines.zh: 我从保育室的地缝里出来。
lines.en: I came out of a floor crack in the nursery.

lines.zh: 蚁穴在沙漠底下，我生在那里。
lines.en: The hive lies under the desert; I was born there.

lines.zh: 第一批活是搬自己的壳。
lines.en: My first job was carrying off my own shell.

lines.zh: 我出生就被分到了运货的队。
lines.en: At birth I was assigned to the hauling crew.

lines.zh: 丛林那边的巢也一样挤。
lines.en: The jungle hive is just as crowded.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看见的全是脚。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and saw only legs.

lines.zh: 巢给我一只旧囊，让我背着。
lines.en: The hive gave me an old sac to carry.

lines.zh: 幼虫比我小，我却得让路。
lines.en: The larvae are smaller, yet I step aside for them.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里挣出来，先学走路。
lines.en: I worked free of the pupa and learned to walk.

lines.zh: 通道口的风，是我第一次见的天。
lines.en: The wind at the tunnel mouth was my first sky.

lines.zh: 火把我背上的干粮点着了。
lines.en: The fire caught the rations on my back.

lines.zh: 我从沙坡滚下来，货压在身上。
lines.en: I rolled down a sand slope with the load on top of me.

lines.zh: 洞里渗水，我的气门闭上了。
lines.en: Water seeped into the burrow and my spiracles shut.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，通道塌了半截。
lines.en: A dull boom, and half the tunnel caved in.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的腹节，我卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow went through my abdomen; I am stuck.

lines.zh: 有股力把我从地上提起来。
lines.en: Some force lifted me off the ground.

lines.zh: 粮仓见底，我饿得走不动。
lines.en: The store is empty; hunger stops my legs.

lines.zh: 雷打进沙里，我的脚全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sand and numbed all my feet.

lines.zh: 我掉出巢道，风从下面往上吹。
lines.en: I fell out of the tunnel, wind blowing up from below.
